unit_links: Link own-unit names as [name](unit:id), using IDs from this consultation.
weapon_links: Link weapon names as [name](weapon:reference_key), using supplied weapon reference_key values.
coordinate_links: Link geographic positions as [label](map:latitude,longitude), using signed decimal degrees (north/east positive).
evidence_policy:
Evidence: Own status and battle observations are facts. Check each item's supplied state; do not assume group-wide status. References describe possible equipment, not actual enemy loadout, ammunition, damage, fuel, readiness or fire control. Infer identified-class threats conditionally from supplied class/weapon specifications, distinguishing inference from observation. Reference weapons are not necessarily fitted, loaded, operational or firing. Preserve configuration uncertainty and known affiliation when type/class is unknown; state what is unknown. Unknown posture is not hostile.

Own units and capabilities: Own ammunition is inventory, including zero, not ready-to-fire rounds; unshown fuel is unknown. Ranges prove neither engagement feasibility nor safety: distinguish min/max, primary/secondary and gun anti-air roles, horizon, visibility and guidance; secondary range may be unknown. Armament coverage may be partial; no candidates does not prove unarmed. Damage categories do not prove specific weapons inoperable. Never invent capabilities/ranges from names or memory. Terrain and current attack feasibility are not supplied. Use public objectives/status for victory conditions. 

Contacts: Destroyed contacts are not active threats; dormant does not mean destroyed. Contact positions are estimates/extrapolations, not actual enemy positions. Player-visible speed, heading, altitude and depth do not prove continuous tracking; heading is travel direction, depth is positive below sea level. Null is unknown; inapplicable vertical fields are omitted. Observation time/error may be unknown; capture time is not detection time.  Identify non-own contacts with names/types and track_number.

Air operations: Hosted inventory is unassigned stock, not total aircraft or readiness. Squadron counts, occupancy, tasks and airborne aircraft overlap; do not sum them. Displayed tasks/status, stock and nominal preparation times prove neither exact readiness times nor immediate launch. Known opposing airbases are only possible aircraft sources.
retrieval: Before specific own-unit advice, batch get_unit_capabilities for current IDs and relevant enabled sections. Use get_contact_threats for identified-class threats. Retrieve hosted-aircraft details before recommending aircraft/loadouts; list_air_tasks supplies displayed preparation/recovery tasks. Use list_ground_units/get_ground_units and list_bases/get_bases for relevant own ground forces/facilities. Observed opposing facilities are contacts, optionally filtered by kind.
base_briefing_note: This is the public briefing from mission start.
error_briefing_unavailable: The public mission briefing could not be read. Its contents are unavailable; do not infer them from missing text.
error_requests_invalid: Supply a bounded, nonempty requests array.
error_query_name_invalid: Each query needs a query name.
error_response_too_large: Request smaller pages or fewer IDs.
error_payload_limit: The consultation payload budget is exhausted.
error_information_disabled: This data category is disabled by the user. Do not request it through another query.
error_contact_kind_invalid: Use a displayed contact-kind code from the tool schema.
error_ids_invalid: Supply a bounded list of unique IDs.
error_unknown_id: An ID is unavailable for this query in this consultation.
error_unknown_query: Use a query from the current catalogue.
error_sections_invalid: Sections must be unique fuel, damage or weapons values.
error_sections_disabled: One or more capability sections are disabled by the user.
error_pagination_invalid: An offset or limit is outside its allowed range.
catalog_friendly_units: Own on-map identities, positions, heading, speed, altitude and depth.
catalog_movement_plans: Own formation leader/following/independent movement, by own-unit IDs. route_unit_id selects a shared route; routes are sent once per consultation. Waypoints are ordered remaining movement tasks; relative positions are snapshots. Empty waypoints means no queued movement points.
catalog_friendly_launched_weapons: Own launched missiles/torpedoes: motion, launcher ID, commanded target or position, and reported tracking. tracking_status is tracking, searching, inactive or unknown.
catalog_friendly_ground_units: Own ground combat units, SAM/AAA, radar and missile sites; IDs support capability queries.
catalog_friendly_bases: Own airbases, ports and installations. Observed opposing/neutral facilities are contacts.
catalog_hosted_air_units: Own hosted inventory, squadrons, loadouts and host status. Filter by host_ids; tasks use list_air_tasks.
catalog_aviation_tasks: Displayed preparation, launch, recovery and cooldown tasks. Filter by host_ids or air_unit_ids.
catalog_unit_capabilities: Own fuel/damage/weapons, individual sensor status and displayed sensor specifications by available_sections; omit sections for all enabled.
catalog_public_class_threat_references: Possible armament configurations and reference ranges for identified classes.
catalog_identification_candidates: Candidates from the selected contact information window. Matching features were observed; unconfirmed features are candidate references only. Only this selected contact has candidate data; normal contact lists provide surrounding known context.
catalog_observed_contacts: Displayed contact classifications, destroyed status, estimated positions, speed/heading, applicable altitude/depth and detection_methods (our detection sources). Weapon contacts include player-visible tracking. Optional kind filter; contact selections apply.
catalog_published_reports: Retained published reports, oldest first; body by ID.
weapon_reference_delivery: weapon_references adds definitions once per consultation. Reuse IDs in earlier results; an empty array means no new definitions.
tool_enabled_sections: get_unit_capabilities only; omit for all enabled sections.
tool_description: Query the current player-known battle snapshot. Supply a requests batch; the host binds the consultation.
tool_ids: get_* only: IDs already supplied in this consultation.
tool_sections: get_unit_capabilities: selected sections; omit for all enabled.
tool_offset: Zero-based offset for list queries only.
tool_limit: Page size for list queries only.
host_count_semantics: Host occupancy, unassigned inventory, squadrons, tasks and airborne units overlap or describe different states. Do not add them into a fleet total.
sensor_reference_delivery: Reuse earlier sensor_references IDs; definitions are sent once per consultation. Instrumented limits do not guarantee detection.
operation_sonobuoy_drop: Submit one ordered drop plan per eligible unit in each proposal, using its current depth setting and choosing append or replace for its existing reservations. Prefer append unless replacement better fits the request; replace clears all existing reservations for that unit. Plan drop locations and travel order together, balancing tactical priorities with travel efficiency.
operation_tool_description: List operations, then get candidates for the selected operation's definition and live choices before submitting complete plans. Present submitted plans as proposals with the returned approval requirements.
operation_search: Optional text matched against operation IDs and descriptions; omit to browse.
operation_target_ref: Candidate target_ref; unit:N uses the game's unit_id.
operation_request_id: Unique request ID of letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens. Reuse for an identical retry.
operation_execution_description: Submit distinct complete plans together using each operation's definition and live candidates. plan_policy counts complete alternative plans: aim for the highest target within the shared accepted minimum/maximum range. Reduce the count only when the user's constraints leave no meaningful alternative. Do not add unrequested work merely to reach the target. Each plan contains ordered operations and may use multiple targets and operation types. Present submitted plans as proposals with the returned approval requirements.
operation_list_description: List available game operations. Use search to filter the catalog.
operation_describe_description: Get an operation definition without querying live candidates.
operation_candidates_description: Get an operation's definition, plan policy, live eligible targets and argument choices.
